## Problem

A real native regression reproduced a PQ text-permission rollback: after a thread permission was removed and the durable owner reopened, restoring the old same-epoch owner file admitted the signed request as `Queued`. Key and revocation floors did not bind the complete owner policy.

The real Agentd/App Server product controls also exposed an entry-point failure: sandbox filesystem-helper re-execs reached daemon-only environment loading before helper dispatch, preventing both PQ and classical requests from creating a thread.

## Changes and resulting behavior

- Persist one monotonic `policy_revision` and canonical policy commitment per PQ domain. Bind Agent, issuer, public key, generation, revocation and the thread set inside the same SQLite transaction and original AuthBus recovery checkpoint as issuer pinning.
- Reject old policies, same-revision content changes, old issuer configurations and a fully valid classical downgrade after PQ activation. Legitimate newer PQ policies and keys continue dispatching.
- Add migration 0015 without rewriting reserved migrations. A previously used PQ domain with no policy floor refuses initialization; authenticated migration of that domain remains open.
- Dispatch the existing helper-only arg0 path before daemon-only configuration, preserving helper recognition, sandbox behavior and normal daemon home-before-runtime ordering.
- Add real durable FinalUse, Unix authorizer and Agentd product refusal/recovery controls. Remove five undeclared test-formatting imports while retaining every built-in assertion and all dependency locks.

## Exact published source

- Base: `a575cf03e2bc871a2f48021859c03ace806421c8` from PQ PR #4368.
- Commit: `7ff91a4368bc110c35da789b16916e046f79b42c`.
- Complete tree: `09483e0039f8f900a403e38f791ca62576f46f38`, exactly equal to the frozen local candidate.
- 70 changed/new files; 45 recorded source/SQL/configuration/lock identities. Local stage SHAs in the evidence are execution provenance, not claimed remote commits.

## Actual validation

| Scope | Result | Source stage and limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Contracts library | 187 passed, 0 skipped | Durable FinalUse continuity candidate |
| Evidence library | 129 passed, 1 ignored helper | After policy repair; the normal parent invokes the crash helper |
| Agentd library | 232 passed, 6 ignored | After policy repair; five paired-Chain cases and one learning study remain unexecuted |
| Final affected selection | 22 passed | arg0 7, AuthBus dispatch 10, PQ Unix FinalUse host 5 |
| Final real product entry | 3 passed, 0 skipped | PQ, classical and missing-trust process controls |
| Scoped repository Clippy / final formatter | exit 0 / exit 0 | No final Rust changes; Clippy is not `-D warnings` and retains baseline warnings plus two test-helper warnings |

The final 22 and 3 controls ran after the helper repair and strengthened valid-classical downgrade test. The complete Evidence/Agentd libraries were not rerun at that later source stage. These overlapping selections must not be added into one unique-test total.

The PQ product control rejects a bad signature, then completes the unchanged valid request through control RPC, durable queue, App Server and the HTTP model fixture. It verifies the exact signed text, one model request and one persisted Completed turn; retries and later invalid authority produce no extra request. This is real process/transport execution with a model fixture, not model quality or Cell installation acceptance.

## Evidence and remaining qualification

[Full explanation](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/7ff91a4368bc110c35da789b16916e046f79b42c/qualification/pq-service-recovery-20261101/README.md) and [run/source/binary manifest](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/7ff91a4368bc110c35da789b16916e046f79b42c/qualification/pq-service-recovery-20261101/evidence/manifest.json) retain the actual baseline rollback, first product failures, intermediate fixture/build failures, resource interruptions and lossless raw logs.

RunStart/ObjectiveStart V1, ordinary Cell-v2 PR #4497 integration, exact paired Chain acceptance, independent witness custody, complete external-state rollback, old PQ-domain migration, WAN/confidentiality and W1 quantum work remain unqualified. This draft does not request production activation or certify whole-chain PQ.
